# Princess Light Media

> An AI-native creative studio in Surrey, British Columbia, founded by Noel Lavieille. It produces short-form motion design video ads, UGC-style creative and product films for product brands, and runs done-for-you marketing for local service businesses under the name Admin-Busters.

## Key facts

- Business name: Princess Light Media
- Also operates as: Admin-Busters (local business service line)
- Founder: Noel Lavieille — roughly twenty years in data architecture and business intelligence, most recently at VP level at State Street
- Location: Surrey, British Columbia, Canada (service-area business, no public storefront)
- Phone: 778-238-0206
- Email: hello@princesslight.com
- Website: https://princesslight.com
- In-person service area: Surrey, Langley, Delta, White Rock, Burnaby, Richmond, Coquitlam, New Westminster, Vancouver
- Remote service area: worldwide for video and motion design work
- Pricing model: fixed price quoted per brief; no hourly billing, no retainer
- Production model: one creative brief defines one visual world; every asset in a campaign is produced from it in a single production pass
- Disclosure: production is AI-native — generative video and motion tools, directed and finished by a person. This is disclosed to every client.
- Work labelling: the site publishes both commissioned and spec work; spec pieces are labelled as spec and were not commissioned by the brands shown.

## Services — product brands

- [Services overview](https://princesslight.com/services/): short-form video ads, UGC-style ads, product and brand films, release and launch packs
- [Selected work](https://princesslight.com/work/): craft beverage, beauty UGC, spirits product film, local service brand video
- [KAIRA / Slow Burn release pack](https://princesslight.com/kaira/): a full demonstration content pack — eleven assets, fourteen-day timeline, one production pass. KAIRA is a fictional artist created for the demonstration.

## Services — local service businesses (Admin-Busters)

- [Admin-Busters overview](https://princesslight.com/local/): online booking, automated reminders, client follow-up, review generation, Google Business Profile optimisation, social content, video ads
- [Google Business Profile optimisation](https://princesslight.com/local/google-business-profile/): eight-step listing cleanup and monthly management, with a free fifteen-minute audit
- [Problems and fixes across ten industries](https://princesslight.com/local/problems-and-fixes/): recurring operational problems by trade and the systems that resolve them
- [Hair Salons](https://princesslight.com/local/hair-salon-marketing/): Done-for-you marketing for hair salons and barbershops in Surrey and the Lower Mainland: online booking, no-show reminders, review generation, Google Business Profile and social content.
- [Tattoo Studios](https://princesslight.com/local/tattoo-studio-marketing/): Marketing and booking systems for tattoo studios and artists in Surrey and Metro Vancouver: automated intake with photo upload, deposit collection, consultation scheduling and portfolio content.
- [Med Spas & Clinics](https://princesslight.com/local/med-spa-marketing/): Marketing and lead-response systems for med spas and aesthetic clinics in Surrey and the Lower Mainland: instant lead response, pre-care and aftercare automation, treatment tracking and discreet client comms.
- [Massage Therapy](https://princesslight.com/local/massage-therapy-marketing/): Booking, intake and marketing systems for massage therapy clinics and RMTs in Surrey and Metro Vancouver: no-show reduction, digital intake forms, rebooking prompts and local search.
- [Nail Salons](https://princesslight.com/local/nail-salon-marketing/): Booking, walk-in queue and content systems for nail salons in Surrey and the Lower Mainland: service-duration scheduling, automated reminders, client preference notes and local search.
- [Gyms & Studios](https://princesslight.com/local/gym-marketing/): Lead capture, membership and retention systems for gyms, fitness studios, yoga, pilates and martial arts clubs in Surrey and Metro Vancouver, plus content and local search management.
- [Dog Groomers](https://princesslight.com/local/dog-grooming-marketing/): Booking, reminder and content systems for dog groomers and pet services in Surrey and the Lower Mainland: breed-specific scheduling, vaccination checks, no-show reduction and local search.

- "Admin-Busters" and "Princess Light Media" are the same business, not separate companies.
